statement: N-0079 budget ledger rules. Questions: (1) grain of a budget: per product line per quarter, per customer per quarter, or both; (2) who allocates (admin only, or planner for own lines); (3) the 50/50 policy question from the spec: is promotion support split 50/50 between ASUS and the customer by default, and does the ledger track only the ASUS half; (4) what counts as committed: case approved, or case approved and exported to the customer; (5) what counts as consumed: claim settled, or payment received. Evidence: docs/SPEC_CPOR_V1_AND_LISTING_CAPTURE_V0.md section 9.7; Budgets page shows allocation/commitment/actual not recorded; planner budget check uses the lineup-derived profit reservation. Reversibility: medium (ledger rows are history). Resolving step: Warren answers 1-5.
